scope: Public AND/OR/negative-filter feature concepts only; no implementation or test-suite files opened and no documentation examples copied
publicConcepts: Rule operators can combine conditions by conjunction and alternatives
Negative conditions can exclude selected results

nativePolicy.format: Original pattern.tree all/any arrays and not object; not Semgrep configuration or range-intersection semantics
nativePolicy.candidate: Every clause inspects the same candidate node; fields may select anonymous tokens; no ancestor/descendant/range search
nativePolicy.captures: Base kind/text/capture/fields/children run first; each clause inherits a separate copy of parent captures; temporary bindings never escape the clause, even on success; nested filters follow the same scope
nativePolicy.evaluation: Conjunction, alternatives and exclusion all constrain the candidate; all/any short-circuit in array order; no capture-assignment backtracking
nativePolicy.limits: 1 to 128 clauses per all/any list; one pattern per not; existing shared pattern node/depth/metadata and per-file comparison budgets include predicates and copied binding entries
nativePolicy.compatibility: No-predicate methods unchanged; enabled filters additionally record isolated-candidate-filters-v1; baseline method changes require reviewed migration
nativePolicy.remaining: No Semgrep syntax, range/binding-equivalence or exhaustive rule/case parity; no dataflow, taint, type/import/constant semantics or autofix
